newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Delifrance in Indonesia franchise pact.
newsitem.headline: Delifrance in Indonesia franchise pact.

text.p: Delifrance Asia Ltd said on Wednesday it has entered a franchise agreement with PT Citra Bonang to operate retail outlets in Indonesia.
The company said in a statement the 50:50 joint venture company, likely to be named PT Delifrance Nusantara, aimed to open 120 Delifrance cafe bakeries in Indonesia by 2006.
The franchise and joint venture would be for nine months from June 28, 1997, renewable for further nine years with subsequent renewals to be negotiated, it said.
"This franchise and joint venture in Indonesia is expected to bring a positive contribution to the group's earnings and net tangible assets in the coming years," Delifrance said.
It said the group was negotiating similar franchise agreements in the region, but gave no further details.
The expansion plan will be financed through internal resources, the statement said.
